ET Stand (for 200 PCS)

A stand that holds E-type retaining rings upright, aligned in units of 200 on a rail or tape stack, so individual rings can be pulled out and fitted one at a time; used together with the ET holder (dedicated insertion tool). It comes in rail-type and tape-type versions depending on the stack method — please refer to the drawings below for each spec.
